crossRefs.note: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”
I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.

translations.web: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.
translations.bsb: And when Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to Him.
translations.kjv: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
translations.asv: And she, when she heard it, arose quickly, and went unto him.
